dedupe_keys.name: emilia romagna coastal defence bathymetric profiles 1984 2000

description: The Region of Emilia-Romagna and ARPA publish topographic and bathymetric survey profiles collected for the regional Adriatic coastal-defence plan. The four native entries comprise a general profile archive and survey campaigns labelled 1984, 1994 and 2000. Their stated purpose is to organise current and historical bathymetry and compare seabed evolution, with particular attention to the submerged beach between zero and six metres depth. Native lineage records 142 cross-shore sections for 1984, 139 for 1994 and 225 for 2000. The general archive also mentions 142 sections; it may overlap the campaign entries and is not counted as an additional survey. Coordinates supplied in XYZ text were converted to point Shapefiles and regional coordinate systems. The explicit coastal-defence planning purpose establishes an infrastructure-related supporting input. The metadata does not establish a particular numerical simulation, design standard, validated model or present beach condition, so specific simulation uses remain unspecified. The provider lists Shapefile and coastal-information-system access routes. All four records state CC BY 4.0 and no public-access limitation. No survey file, data rows, map or linked article body was read.
